response.description: SASRec encodes interaction histories using learned item and position embeddings, causal self-attention, and feed-forward blocks. It ranks candidate items by dot products with the final history representation. Training uses next-item binary cross-entropy with sampled negatives. Source: [Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781v1).
response.motivation: Attention selects relevant past interactions, combining short-range transitions with longer-range preferences. Despite the supplied title, SASRec is not a dedicated cold-start method: unseen items lack learned interaction embeddings, and users without history lack personalized context.
response.implementation_notes: Start from sasrec_perdataset and preserve separate models and routing for Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Keep DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and the effective 200-epoch default. Preserve input splits and select changes using macro validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator. Write checkpoints and the matching predictor beneath the trial directory. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), adapting probes to the actual model and reporting measured metrics with definitions. Use only available public fields. Any content-based cold-start extension would be an additional proposal requiring validation; no improvement is established here.
response.pseudocode:
for category in four_categories:
    load unchanged benchmark splits
    initialize category SASRec with seed 42
    for epoch in configured_epochs(default=200):
        for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
            features = model.log2feats(sequence)
            positive_logits = model.predict_score(features, positive)
            negative_logits = model.predict_score(features, negative)
            loss = masked_BCE(positive_logits, 1) + masked_BCE(negative_logits, 0)
            optimize(loss)
    save model configuration and checkpoint
write predictor that restores matching models and category routing
compare trials using host macro validation HR@10 within the shared budget

originality.positive: The paper provides an influential attention-based formulation of sequential recommendation.
originality.negative: Using SASRec directly adds little novelty because it is already the required baseline. Score uses a 1–10 scale for this task's proposal.

future_potential.positive: Available titles and descriptions could support a separately validated extension for items with sparse interactions.
future_potential.negative: Benefits on the four matched datasets remain unmeasured; empty-history personalization still needs a fallback.

code_difficulty.positive: The existing baseline and compatibility contract reduce implementation effort.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require synchronized checkpoint loading, predictor generation, and diagnostic probes. Higher scores indicate greater difficulty.
